title: Cubic Nonlinear Schrödinger Systems and Orthonormal Fermionic Ground States in $\mathbb R$
summary: We study the one-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger system \[ -u_i''-2\Big(\sum_{k=1}^N u_k^2\Big)^{p-1}u_i=μ_i u_i \quad \mbox{in } \ \mathbb R,\ \ i=1,2,\cdots,N, \tag{S} \] where $u=(u_1,\cdots,u_N)\in H^1(\mathbb{R})^N$, $μ_1\leqμ_2\leq\cdots\leqμ_N 0$ such that $J_N(p)$ is attained for any $p\in(2-δ_N,2)$, whereas $J_N(p)$ is not attained for any $p\in[2,2+δ_N)$. These settle some conjectures of [Gontier--Lewin--Nazar, ARMA, 2021] and [Frank--Gontier--Lewin, CMP, 2021].
